method: Fresh private Windows processes, isolated offline profiles, Vulkan Forward+ 1280x720 and 60 FPS for paired launches.

The stage probes subclass the frozen scripts, copy the exact ready callback and add timestamps. Their first load compiles diagnostic scripts and adds pre-attachment time. Use the stage probes to compare work after attachment.
Renderer signals delimit render submission and completion notifications. They are not GPU hardware-timer results.
The compiled pairs retain the shipping scene and add an autoload observer. The matching viewport driver opens Story, sorties, advances the three dialogue pages, moves a unit and returns to the menu.
The six-route run is a short compatibility check.
